_comment: Per-chapter metadata for the CA ELA/ELD Framework extraction pipeline. span_keys are the ELPAC writing-domain grade spans (K | 1-2 | 3-12) this chapter's content maps to. span_notes explain the assignment logic.

3.title: Content and Pedagogy: Transitional Kindergarten Through Grade One
3.span_notes: TK and Kindergarten content → K; Grade 1 content → 1-2; span-wide TK–1 moves duplicate to both.

4.title: Content and Pedagogy: Grades Two and Three
4.span_notes: Grade 2 content → 1-2; Grade 3 content → 3-12; span-wide 2–3 moves duplicate to both.

5.title: Content and Pedagogy: Grades Four and Five
5.span_notes: All grades 4-5 content maps to the 3-12 ELPAC writing span.

6.title: Content and Pedagogy: Grades Six Through Eight
6.span_notes: All grades 6-8 content maps to the 3-12 ELPAC writing span.

7.title: Content and Pedagogy: Grades Nine Through Twelve
7.span_notes: All grades 9-12 content maps to the 3-12 ELPAC writing span.
